text.zh_CN: 经理，你好……我教了一辈子语文，真的不懂你们大屏幕上那些花花绿绿的指标和模型。这笔钱是我和老伴辛苦攒了一辈子的退休积蓄。学院推荐我找你……我就想知道，市场最坏最坏的时候，我还能剩下多少？
text.en: Manager... hello. I taught literature all my life; I don't understand the charts, Greeks, or models. This is my wife's and my retirement savings. The academy sent me to you... I just need to know: in the worst case, how much would I have left?

text.zh_CN: 王老师，何必那么悲观！看看我们策略的回测，年化收益超过 35%！远望交易学院的量化动量系统全行业顶尖，只要大势在，跑赢通胀轻轻松松！放心把规模交给我们，绝不让您吃亏！
text.en: Mr. Wang, why so gloomy? Look at the backtest of our strategy: over 35% annualized! Farview's quantitative momentum engine is industry-best. As long as macro trends hold, beating inflation is child's play! Trust us with full allocation; we'll treat you like royalty!

text.zh_CN: 顾言，立刻住口。远望的第一条底线是：永不向客户承诺收益。第二条是：绝不隐瞒风险。把别人的积蓄当成自己的赌资，是受托人最不能碰的红线。
text.en: Gu Yan, stop. Farview's first rule: never promise returns. Second: never hide risk. Treating someone's savings as gambling capital is the one line a fiduciary must never cross.

text.zh_CN: 从给自己下单，到替别人管理资金，这是业余散户和职业掌舵人的真正分界线。王先生问的是一个底线问题。你是远望一期的拟任经理，你给委托人什么承诺？
text.en: Moving from trading your own account to managing other people's money is the real line between an amateur and a professional. Mr. Wang is asking about your bottom line. You're the proposed manager of Farview Fund I. What do you promise your client?

text.zh_CN: 向客户王先生进行风险沟通与路演承诺：
text.en: Communicate risk boundaries and investor commitment to Mr. Wang:

text.zh_CN: 据实说明最坏极端情景（回撤可能达 15%），降低客户预期，坚守诚实底线。
text.en: Disclose worst-case drawdowns honestly (up to 15%); temper expectations and uphold fiduciary duty.

toast.zh_CN: 客户沟通：坦白风险底线，赢得王先生深度信任
toast.en: Client trust forged: Transparent risk disclosure

text.zh_CN: 着重强调过往卓越回报与风控模型，弱化极端风险，以促成最大规模认购。
text.en: Emphasize stellar historical gains and downplay tails to secure maximum AUM subscription.

toast.zh_CN: 客户沟通：过度渲染收益，客户对潜在回撤毫无准备
toast.en: Client communication: Overpromised return, disguised risk

text.zh_CN: 谢谢你……你是第一个愿意看着我的眼睛，跟我讲最坏会亏多少的人。知道最坏只有 15%，我心里就有数了。我信你，请替我们看好这笔钱。
text.en: Thank you. You're the first manager willing to look me in the eye and state how much I could lose. Knowing the bottom line is 15% gives me peace of mind. I trust you. Please guard our nest egg.

text.zh_CN: 王先生满怀发财的憧憬签了字。但你记住：当你说出第一句好听的虚饰之词时，一旦风暴降临，你将失去所有退路。
text.en: Mr. Wang signed with dreams of quick wealth. But remember: the first smooth reassurance you give him will leave you no honorable way out when the storm comes.

text.zh_CN: 去基金管理大厅查看远望一期的净值与客户份额。从今往后，每一个数字跳动，背后都连着一个家庭的期望与尊严。
text.en: Review Farview Fund's NAV and client units on the Fund screen. Henceforth, every single basis point tick carries the livelihood and dignity of real families.
